partnershipPlan: Two pneumonia survivors from the registry's patient panel review the outcomes and the plain-language summary; cardiology and respiratory clinicians review the covariate list.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I got over the infection, but a year later I still could not walk to the shops.
items.implication: Keep care home entry and death alongside cardiovascular events.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Dad came home from hospital and was in a care home within three months; nobody had talked about that possibility.
items.implication: Report the timing of care home entry after discharge.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I tell patients their heart risk doubles for ten years, and I realise I do not know where that came from.
items.implication: Report local estimates and correct the untraced figure.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I cannot bring every pneumonia survivor back to clinic; tell me which ones to see.

summary: Four composite voices on recovery, care home entry, the untraced figure and targeting follow-up.
